### Decision Pathway Flowchart

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=14, fig.height=6.8, dpi=300}
library(diagram)

par(mar = c(0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 0.2), xpd = NA)
openplotmat()

# Retrieve user pathway selections
active_nodes <- params$selected_nodes
if (is.null(active_nodes)) active_nodes <- character(0)

active_edges <- params$selected_edges
if (is.null(active_edges)) active_edges <- character(0)

# Step order numbering for badge overlays
node_step_order <- setNames(seq_along(active_nodes), active_nodes)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. COLUMN BACKGROUNDS & HEADERS
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Exact 7 column bounds and their authentic pastel shades
bounds <- c(0.00, 0.108, 0.218, 0.328, 0.478, 0.690, 0.795, 1.00)
col_colors <- c('#eef0f2', '#e5f1df', '#f0e5f2', '#fff1cc',
                '#f5e6da', '#e2ebf7', '#dbe0e5')

# Reserve space at the bottom for the 3 numbered notes (y: 0.05 to 0.94)
for (i in seq_along(col_colors)) {
  rect(bounds[i], 0.06, bounds[i + 1], 0.945, col = col_colors[i], border = NA)
}

# Header bar
rect(0, 0.945, 1, 1.00, col = '#e0e0e0', border = NA)

headers <- c('High threat hazard', 'Exposure', 'Severity',
             'Spread potential', 'Capacity', 'Risk classification', 'Actions')
for (i in seq_along(headers)) {
  text(mean(bounds[c(i, i + 1)]), 0.973, headers[i], font = 2, cex = 0.78, col = "#111111")
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. NODE DEFINITIONS (Matching column fills and exact coordinates)
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
nodes <- list(
  # Column 1: Hazard
  hazard = list(.054, .820, .046, .090,
                'Does the signal or\nevent involve a high\nthreat hazard? (e.g.\nviral hemorrhagic\nfevers, poliomyelitis\ndue to wild type)', '#eef0f2', .58),
  
  # Column 2: Exposure
  exposure = list(.163, .820, .046, .046,
                  'Is further exposure\nlikely to take place?', '#e5f1df', .64),
  
  # Column 3: Severity
  severity = list(.273, .645, .046, .078,
                  'Is the disease likely to\ncause moderate to\nsevere disease in this\npopulation/group?', '#f0e5f2', .63),
  
  # Column 4: Spread Potential
  current = list(.403, .820, .048, .060,
                 'Are a significant\nnumber of people\ncurrently affected?', '#fff1cc', .63),
  future1 = list(.403, .645, .050, .074,
                 'Would a high number\nof cases or substantial\ngeographical spread be\nexpected in the future?', '#fff1cc', .59),
  future2 = list(.403, .435, .050, .074,
                 'Would a high number\nof cases or substantial\ngeographical spread be\nexpected in the future?', '#fff1cc', .59),
  
  # Column 5: Capacity & Healthcare
  healthcare = list(.530, .285, .044, .056,
                    'Is the healthcare\nsystem likely to be\noverwhelmed?', '#f5e6da', .61),
  cap1 = list(.634, .685, .046, .058,
              'Are capacity for\nprevention and\ncontrol measures in\nplace?', '#f5e6da', .59),
  cap2 = list(.634, .475, .046, .058,
              'Are capacity for\nprevention and\ncontrol measures in\nplace?', '#f5e6da', .59),
  cap3 = list(.634, .290, .046, .058,
              'Are capacity for\nprevention and\ncontrol measures in\nplace?', '#f5e6da', .59),
  cap4 = list(.634, .118, .046, .058,
              'Are capacity for\nprevention and\ncontrol measures in\nplace?', '#f5e6da', .59),
  
  # Column 6: Risk Classification
  risk1 = list(.745, .820, .036, .030, 'Very low', '#57a75c', .75),
  risk2 = list(.745, .660, .036, .030, 'Low',      '#99c65d', .75),
  risk3 = list(.745, .475, .036, .030, 'Moderate', '#ffeb4e', .73),
  risk4 = list(.745, .290, .036, .030, 'High',     '#e8b638', .75),
  risk5 = list(.745, .118, .036, .030, 'Very high','#d94334', .73),
  
  # Column 7: Actions
  action1 = list(.897, .820, .095, .044,
                 '• Signal discarded\n• Business as usual', '#57a75c', .66),
  action2 = list(.897, .660, .095, .096,
                 '• Monitor the signal through routine\n  surveillance system\n• If necessary, share information with\n  neighbouring provinces/regions and/or\n  relevant offices/colleagues', '#99c65d', .59),
  action3 = list(.897, .475, .095, .100,
                 '• Inform management at one level higher\n  than “normal”\n• Consider deploying rapid response team\n  to the affected area\n• Provide necessary support, such as\n  enhanced surveillance, laboratory testing,\n  epi investigation, clinical management and\n  supply of relevant materials, diagnostics,\n  vaccines and therapeutics.', '#ffeb4e', .52),
  action4 = list(.897, .290, .095, .084,
                 '• Inform management at one level higher\n  than “moderate”\n• Deploy rapid response team to the\n  affected area\n• Consider activating the emergency\n  response plan at national or sub-national\n  level', '#e8b638', .57),
  action5 = list(.897, .118, .095, .060,
                 '• Inform top level of management\n• Activate the emergency response plan at\n  national level\n• Consider engaging international assistance', '#d94334', .58)
)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. PATH-AWARE CONNECTOR ROUTER
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
route <- function(id, xy, label = NULL, label_at = NULL) {
  xy <- as.matrix(xy)
  n <- nrow(xy)
  is_selected <- id %in% active_edges

  line_col  <- ifelse(is_selected, "#C62828", "#555555")
  line_lwd  <- ifelse(is_selected, 3.2, 0.95)
  arr_len   <- ifelse(is_selected, 0.11, 0.08)
  text_col  <- ifelse(is_selected, "#B71C1C", "#222222")
  text_font <- ifelse(is_selected, 2, 1)
  text_cex  <- ifelse(is_selected, 0.65, 0.56)

  if (n > 2) {
    for (j in seq_len(n - 2)) {
      segments(xy[j, 1], xy[j, 2], xy[j+1, 1], xy[j+1, 2],
               col = line_col, lwd = line_lwd)
    }
  }
  arrows(xy[n-1, 1], xy[n-1, 2], xy[n, 1], xy[n, 2],
         col = line_col, lwd = line_lwd, length = arr_len)

  if (!is.null(label)) {
    if (is_selected) {
      rect(label_at[1] - 0.020, label_at[2] - 0.012,
           label_at[1] + 0.020, label_at[2] + 0.012,
           col = "#FFEBEE", border = "#C62828", lwd = 1.2)
    }
    text(label_at[1], label_at[2], label, cex = text_cex, font = text_font, col = text_col)
  }
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. DRAW CONNECTORS
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Hazard -> Exposure / Cap4
route("hazard->exposure", rbind(c(.100, .820), c(.117, .820)), 'No', c(.108, .838))
route("hazard->cap4", rbind(c(.054, .730), c(.054, .118), c(.588, .118)), 'Yes', c(.066, .135))

# Exposure -> Severity / Current
route("exposure->severity", rbind(c(.163, .774), c(.163, .645), c(.227, .645)), 'Yes/unk', c(.184, .660))
route("exposure->current", rbind(c(.209, .820), c(.355, .820)), 'No', c(.270, .835))

# Severity -> Current / Future2
route("severity->current", rbind(c(.319, .645), c(.337, .645), c(.337, .820), c(.355, .820)), 'No', c(.332, .665))
route("severity->future2", rbind(c(.273, .567), c(.273, .435), c(.353, .435)), 'Yes/unk', c(.296, .450))

# Current -> Very Low (risk1) / Cap1
route("current->risk1", rbind(c(.451, .820), c(.709, .820)), 'No', c(.584, .835))
route("current->cap1", rbind(c(.403, .760), c(.403, .700), c(.502, .700), c(.588, .685)), 'Yes', c(.478, .715))

# Future1 -> Cap1 / Low (risk2)
route("future1->cap1", rbind(c(.453, .645), c(.528, .645), c(.588, .685)), 'Yes', c(.520, .660))
route("future1->risk2", rbind(c(.453, .630), c(.562, .630), c(.562, .660), c(.709, .660)), 'No', c(.482, .645))

# Future2 -> Cap2 / Healthcare
route("future2->cap2", rbind(c(.453, .435), c(.588, .475)), 'No', c(.506, .462))
route("future2->healthcare", rbind(c(.403, .361), c(.403, .285), c(.486, .285)), 'Yes/unk', c(.432, .300))

# Healthcare -> Cap3 / Cap4
route("healthcare->cap3", rbind(c(.574, .285), c(.588, .290)), 'No', c(.575, .305))
route("healthcare->cap4", rbind(c(.530, .229), c(.530, .118), c(.588, .118)), 'Yes', c(.542, .185))

# Capacity -> Risk Classifications
route("cap1->risk1", rbind(c(.680, .705), c(.709, .820)), 'Yes', c(.698, .748))
route("cap1->risk2", rbind(c(.680, .685), c(.709, .660)), 'No/unk', c(.694, .682))

route("cap2->risk2", rbind(c(.680, .495), c(.709, .660)), 'Yes', c(.698, .550))
route("cap2->risk3", rbind(c(.680, .475), c(.709, .475)), 'No/unk', c(.694, .490))

route("cap3->risk3", rbind(c(.680, .308), c(.709, .475)), 'Yes', c(.698, .360))
route("cap3->risk4", rbind(c(.680, .290), c(.709, .290)), 'No/unk', c(.694, .305))

route("cap4->risk4", rbind(c(.680, .135), c(.709, .290)), 'Yes', c(.697, .195))
route("cap4->risk5", rbind(c(.680, .118), c(.709, .118)), 'No/unk', c(.694, .134))

# Risk level -> Action boxes
for (y in c(.820, .660, .475, .290, .118)) {
  route(paste0("risk->action_", y), rbind(c(.781, y), c(.802, y)))
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. DRAW BOXES (With authentic borders & Step Number Badges)
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
for (nm in names(nodes)) {
  a <- nodes[[nm]]
  is_selected <- nm %in% active_nodes

  border_col <- ifelse(is_selected, "#C62828", "black")
  border_lwd <- ifelse(is_selected, 3.2, 0.9)

  diagram::textrect(
    mid = c(a[[1]], a[[2]]),
    radx = a[[3]],
    rady = a[[4]],
    lab = a[[5]],
    box.col = a[[6]],
    cex = a[[7]],
    shadow.size = 0,
    lcol = border_col,
    lwd = border_lwd
  )

  # Numbered step badge on visited nodes: ①, ②, ③
  if (is_selected && nm %in% names(node_step_order)) {
    step_num <- node_step_order[[nm]]
    badge_x  <- a[[1]] - a[[3]] + 0.007
    badge_y  <- a[[2]] + a[[4]] - 0.008
    points(badge_x, badge_y, pch = 21, bg = "#C62828", col = "white", cex = 1.9, lwd = 1.4)
    text(badge_x, badge_y, step_num, col = "white", font = 2, cex = 0.58)
  }
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. BOTTOM FOOTNOTES (Matching reference diagram)
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
rect(0, 0.00, 1.00, 0.06, col = "#f8f9fa", border = NA)
text(0.01, 0.046, "1. If there is a risk of international spread of the event, information should be promptly shared with neighbouring countries and areas. Neighbouring countries are encouraged to assess the risk associated with possible importation of the diseases.", adj = 0, cex = 0.52, col = "#333333")
text(0.01, 0.030, "2. If there is high level of public concern or political sensitivities, the event may require higher speed of information release, more intensive risk communication, & more engagement of higher level management.", adj = 0, cex = 0.52, col = "#333333")
text(0.01, 0.014, "3. The first case of PHEIC diseases should be notified to WHO regardless of risk level.", adj = 0, cex = 0.52, col = "#333333")
```
